content_of_post_to_comment: After some thinking, I have made the decision to leave Discord. I have been there for almost exactly 10 years, but as time passed, I began to associate it with pain rather than joy. The first major group that I tried joining was full of cliques that would exclude me even when I asked to join them. A second group then accepted me in, but they turned out to be some very severe bullies who kicked me out for having autism and then making fun of me and my OCs behind my back(this forced me to change my username and main OC to something that they would not recognize). I then tried joining a whole circle of servers, but felt left out of all of those because the members went to different servers all of the time, and one of the members of those servers was a really cranky user who sounded and typed like he was mad all of the time, even when he wasn't. The way he talked and tone he used hurt me immensely on a personal mental level. And I also had trouble with the MLP fandom on Discord. I tried telling a joke in a big MLP server, but had it absolutely roasted. And a couple of months after that I had a user be rude to me in an MLP server I was formerly a part of, and not just that, when I told the server owner about her, he did nothing about her and said I was overreacting. Then I learned that the server owner was not as good of a guy as I thought. I have no idea how someone who is almost a decade and a half older than me and is almost 50 years old acts like that. Not just that, but when I have asked people for servers to join to replace ones I have lost, they would respond with "I don't know", forcing me to use Google and Disboard. And in one decent server I was in, there were a few users who formed a clique and would outright ignore me if I tried talking to them. Between feeling left out and excluded, getting into drama, losing servers, being told "I don't know" when asking for new ones, and having that place take an enormous toll on my mental health, I have had enough. So I feel like it's time to close that chapter of my life. I have scheduled my account for deletion and it will terminate on the 16th.
